candidates.source_name: Bankar.me — Poslovni portal (Montenegro banking/finance trade portal)
candidates.why_relevant: The only Montenegrin outlet specialising in banking/finance. Publishes dedicated personnel/management stories (e.g. a survey piece on changes in the governing structures of Montenegrin banks, board/supervisory-board formation after AGMs), interviews with newly appointed bank CEOs, and even reproduces bank and CBCG job vacancies. This is the single highest-yield media source for A5 (jobs, hiring, leadership moves, organization changes) in Montenegro.

negative_findings.description: The cell brief names 'Analitika' as a target outlet. The domain analitika.me does NOT serve that outlet: a request to https://www.analitika.me/ redirects to https://fv88.llc/, an unrelated third-party site. The Montenegrin outlet is Portal Analitika at portalanalitika.me, whose business vertical is /abiznis.
negative_findings.result_summary: analitika.me -> 302/redirect chain terminating at fv88.llc (HTTP 200 on the wrong host); portalanalitika.me -> HTTP 200 with /abiznis, /najnovije, /politika, /drustvo sections.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collecting analitika.me would ingest content from an unrelated (likely gambling/parked) domain and would silently produce zero real Montenegrin coverage while appearing healthy. The source register must pin portalanalitika.me and explicitly blocklist analitika.me.

negative_findings.description: The available web search is US-indexed and returns almost no results from .me news domains even for well-formed Serbian/Montenegrin queries. Local-language queries about Montenegrin bank appointments repeatedly returned Wikipedia, Croatian, Serbian and Slovenian results instead of the Montenegrin outlets actually named in the query.
negative_findings.result_summary: Five separate sr-language queries (Vijesti banka novi izvršni direktor; Pobjeda smjena rukovodstva otkazi; CdM reorganizacija zatvaranje filijala; Dan imenovan glavni izvršni direktor; sindikat radnici otkazi) each returned zero on-target articles from the named outlet. Only Bankar.me was reliably indexed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Source discovery and, later, content collection for this cell cannot rely on this search engine. Collection must be built on direct site crawling, RSS polling and each outlet's own on-site search endpoint (e.g. vijesti.me/pretraga?q=, portalanalitika.me/pretraga) rather than on general web search.

negative_findings.description: Several primary outlets refused the default HTML fetcher. dan.co.me returned HTTP 403 on both / and /ekonomija even with a desktop-Chrome User-Agent; vijesti.me HTML could not be retrieved at all; cdm.me, mina.news and bankar.me category pages returned 403 while their RSS feeds returned 200.
negative_findings.result_summary: 403/blocked at HTML layer for dan.co.me, vijesti.me, cdm.me/ekonomija, mina.news business section, bankar.me/category/*; 200 for bankar.me/feed/, cdm.me/feed/, mina.news/feed/, vijesti.me/rss, vijesti.me/rss/vijesti.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are bot-defence hypotheses, not dead sources — RSS success on the same hosts proves the sites are live. The collection design should prefer feeds and, where no feed exists (dan.co.me), budget for a headless-browser fetcher. Do not mark any of these as dead.

negative_findings.description: No economy/banking-scoped RSS feed was found for the largest outlets. vijesti.me/rss/ekonomija returned 404 (only the site-wide /rss and /rss/vijesti exist); antenam.net/rss returned 404; ekonomist.me/feed/ returned 404; pobjeda.me/feed returned 200 but yielded no parseable item titles.
negative_findings.result_summary: Section-scoped feeds absent; site-wide feeds are high-volume and heavily mixed with sport/entertainment (the cdm.me and mina.news feeds sampled were dominated by sport and world news).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Feed polling alone will bury banking personnel items in noise. The pipeline needs a keyword/actor classifier applied to site-wide feeds, plus URL-path filtering on /ekonomija, rather than assuming a clean sector feed exists.

negative_findings.description: Despite targeted local-language searching, no Montenegrin outlet was found to run a standing, named 'personnel column' (a recurring 'kadrovske promjene' / 'ljudi i karijere' rubric) of the kind common in larger markets. The closest observed is Bankar.me publishing periodic one-off survey articles on changes in bank governing structures.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for kadrovske promjene rubrics returned only individual Bankar.me articles, not a persistent section URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection cannot subscribe to a single high-precision personnel rubric; it must instead run recall-oriented keyword sweeps across general economy sections, which raises the volume and the need for filtering.

negative_findings.description: English-language reporting on Montenegrin bank layoffs, restructuring and branch closures is effectively absent. English searching returned only expat banking guides, thebanks.eu sector aggregation and generic sector-consolidation background, with no outlet-level personnel reporting.
negative_findings.result_summary: The English query returned nomadcapitalist, thebanks.eu, montenegroguides and an IMF letter of intent — no news reporting on Montenegrin bank personnel or restructuring events.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that Serbian/Montenegrin-language collection is not optional for this cell but the only viable channel. Any English-only monitoring configuration for ME would be structurally blind.

coverage_gaps.description: Dan (dan.co.me) — a named cell target and one of the two most likely outlets for contested dismissal reporting — could not be reached at all (403 on every path tried). Its section structure, search endpoint and feed availability are entirely unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-attempt with a headless browser (Playwright/Selenium with a real profile) from a European IP; map its /ekonomija or /rubrika structure and any on-site search; if still blocked, evaluate its e-paper/print archive or a press-clipping service as the access route.

coverage_gaps.description: The local-language glossary used here (kadrovske promjene, smjena, razriješen, imenovan, ostavka, otkazi, zatvaranje filijala/ekspoziture, odbor direktora, nadzorni odbor, glavni izvršni direktor) was assembled from observed article titles, but was never validated against a real corpus of Montenegrin bank personnel articles because search would not surface them. Noisy terms are also unflagged — notably 'Pobjeda' (an outlet name AND the common noun 'victory', which polluted every query) and 'Dan' (an outlet name AND the word 'day').
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Once site-level crawling of Bankar.me and vijesti.me/pretraga is running, mine 100-200 retrieved headlines to build a frequency-validated term list; explicitly encode 'Pobjeda' and 'Dan' as site-restricted terms (site:pobjeda.me, site:dan.co.me) never to be used as free-text keywords.

coverage_gaps.description: Trade-union and works-council voice is not covered by any source found in this cell. Layoff and restructuring disputes are usually first articulated by a union (Unija slobodnih sindikata Crne Gore / Savez sindikata Crne Gore and any banking-sector branch), and media only report them once the union speaks. No union source or union-sector-branch page was located during this sweep.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sweep for Savez sindikata Crne Gore, Unija slobodnih sindikata Crne Gore and any 'sindikat bankarstva / sindikalna organizacija' pages at individual banks; add their announcement pages as direct sources feeding this media cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Broadcast-only outlets (TV Vijesti, Nova M / TV Prva, RTCG television) were not assessed. Interviews with newly appointed bankers frequently air on television and are only partially transcribed to the web, meaning appointment context is lost to a text-only pipeline.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess the YouTube channels and on-demand archives of TV Vijesti, Nova M and RTCG for banking-guest programming; consider ASR transcription of business-interview shows if volume justifies it.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/back-catalogue access route was established for any outlet. All the endpoints found expose only current content; feeds are rolling windows. Reconstructing a multi-year history of who led which Montenegrin bank when — the baseline any leadership-move signal is measured against — is not currently possible from these sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish an archival route: outlet on-site search with date filters, Wayback Machine CDX queries against vijesti.me/vijesti/ekonomija, bankar.me and pobjeda.me, and Bankar.me's dated permalink pattern (/YYYY/MM/DD/slug/) which allows systematic date-range enumeration.

coverage_gaps.description: MINA's full agency wire (MINA-business) is the upstream origin of much downstream bank-appointment coverage, but its subscription terms, price and delivery format (feed vs. email vs. portal) were not established — the business section returned 403 and no pricing page was reached.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Contact MINA directly to establish MINA-business subscription terms and whether a machine-readable feed is offered; a wire subscription would deduplicate five downstream portals and remove most bot-defence problems in this cell.

brief: Montenegro's media landscape for banking personnel intelligence is small, concentrated and Serbian/Montenegrin-only: Bankar.me is the single indispensable source, being the country's only banking trade portal and the one outlet that runs recurring pieces on changes in bank governing structures, CEO interviews and bank vacancy notices, while MINA's agency wire is the upstream origin of much of what the general portals republish. Contested events — dismissals, resignations, union disputes, branch closures — surface through the national dailies (Vijesti, Dan, Pobjeda) and the high-volume portals (CdM, Portal Analitika, RTCG), with partisan portals (Borba, IN4S) acting as early but unreliable tripwires that always need corroboration. Two structural problems dominate collection design: general web search is effectively blind to .me news domains, so the pipeline must be built on RSS polling plus each outlet's own search endpoint rather than search engines, and several key sites (dan.co.me hardest, plus the HTML layers of vijesti.me, cdm.me and mina.news) refuse plain fetchers while their feeds serve normally — bot defence, not dead sources. Note one correction to the cell brief: 'Analitika' is portalanalitika.me (business vertical /abiznis); the domain analitika.me now redirects to an unrelated third-party site and must be blocklisted.
